entries.97.1: वाल्मीकिना by Valmiki, एवम् thus, उक्तः तु addressed, राघवः Raghava, जगतः of the assembled world, मध्ये in the midst, ताम् that, वरवर्णिनीम् lady of fair complexion, दृष्ट्वा having seen, प्राञ्जलिः with joined palms, प्रत्यभाषत replied
entries.97.2: महाभाग O greatly blessed one, धर्मवित् O knower of dharma, यथा as, वदसि you say, एतत् this, एवम् is so, ब्रह्मन् O brahmin, अकल्मषैः stainless, तव your, वाक्यैः by words, मम my, प्रत्ययः तु conviction indeed
entries.97.3: पुरा formerly, सुरसन्निधौ in the presence of the gods, वैदेह्याः of Vaidehi, प्रत्ययः तु the proof indeed, वृत्तः took place, तत्र there, शपथः the oath, कृतः was made, तेन therefore, वेश्म into my house, प्रवेशिता she was brought, लोकापवादः the slander of the world, बलवान् was strong, येन whereby, मैथिली Maithili, त्यक्ता हि was indeed abandoned
entries.97.4: ब्रह्मन् O brahmin, सा इयम् this very one, अपापा sinless, इति thus, अभिजानता by me who knew her, लोकभयात् out of fear of the world, मया by me, सीता Sita, परित्यक्ता was cast off, तत् that, भवान् your honour, क्षन्तुम् to forgive, अर्हति ought
entries.97.5: इमौ these two, कुशीलवौ Kusha and Lava, यमजातौ twin-born, मे my, पुत्रौ sons, जानामि च and I know, जगतः of the world, मध्ये in the midst, शुद्धायाम् when she is proved pure, मैथिल्याम् in Maithili, मे my, प्रीतिः joy, अस्तु let there be
entries.97.6: रामस्य of Rama, अभिप्रायम् तु the intent indeed, विज्ञाय having perceived, महौजसः of great might, महेन्द्राद्याः headed by great Indra, सुरसत्तमाः the best of the gods, तस्मिन् at that, सीतायाः of Sita, शपथे oath
entries.97.7: पितामहम् the Grandsire, पुरस्कृत्य having set foremost, सर्वे एव all of them, समागताः came together
entries.97.8: आदित्याः the Adityas, वसवः the Vasus, रुद्राः the Rudras, हि indeed, अश्विनौ the Ashvins, समरुद्गणाः with the hosts of Maruts, गन्धर्वाप्सरसश्चैव and gandharvas and apsaras, सर्वे एव all of them, समागताः came together
entries.97.9: साध्याश्च and the Sadhyas, विश्वेदेवाश्च and the Vishvedevas, सर्वे all, परमर्षयश्च and the supreme sages, नागाः the nagas, सुपर्णाः the suparnas, सिद्धाश्च and the siddhas, ते they, सर्वे all, हृष्टमानसाः glad at heart, सीताशपथसम्भ्रान्ताः stirred by the oath of Sita, सर्वे एव all of them, समागताः came together
entries.97.10: राघवः Raghava, देवान् the gods, ऋषींश्चैव and the sages, दृष्ट्वा having seen, पुनः again, अब्रवीत् said, नरश्रेष्ठाः O best of men, अकल्मषैः stainless, ऋषिवाक्यैः by the words of the sages, मे my, प्रत्ययः conviction
entries.97.11: जगतः of the world, मध्ये in the midst, शुद्धायाम् when she is proved pure, वैदेह्याम् in Vaidehi, मे my, प्रीतिः joy, अस्तु let there be
entries.97.12: ततः then, शुभः auspicious, पुण्यः holy, दिव्यगन्धः of heavenly fragrance, मनोरमः delightful, सुरश्रेष्ठः best of the gods, वायुः the wind, तत् that, जनौघम् throng of people, सर्वतः on every side, ह्लादयामास refreshed
entries.97.13: सर्वराष्ट्रेभ्यः from all the realms, समागताः assembled, मानवाः the men, तत् that, अचिन्त्यम् unthinkable, अद्भुतम् इव a marvel as it were, पूर्वम् formerly, कृतयुगे in the Krita age, यथा as, निरैक्षन्त beheld
entries.97.14: सर्वान् all, समागतान् assembled, दृष्ट्वा having seen, काषायवासिनी clad in ochre, सीता Sita, अधोदृष्टिः her gaze cast down, अवाङ्मुखी her face bent low, प्राञ्जलिः with joined palms, वाक्यम् these words, अब्रवीत् spoke
entries.97.15: यथा as surely as, अहम् I, राघवात् than Raghava, अन्यम् another, मनसा अपि even in thought, न चिन्तये do not think of, तथा so surely, माधवी देवी the goddess Earth, मे to me, विवरम् an opening, दातुम् to give, अर्हति ought
entries.97.16: यथा as surely as, मनसा in thought, कर्मणा in deed, वाचा in word, रामम् Rama, समर्चये I worship, तथा so surely, माधवी देवी the goddess Earth, मे to me, विवरम् an opening, दातुम् to give, अर्हति ought
entries.97.17: यथा as surely as, एतत् this, मे by me, सत्यम् truly, उक्तम् has been spoken, रामात् than Rama, परम् another, न च वेद्मि I know not, तथा so surely, माधवी देवी the goddess Earth, मे to me, विवरम् an opening, दातुम् to give, अर्हति ought
entries.97.18: वैदेह्याम् when Vaidehi, तथा thus, शपन्त्याम् was swearing, तत् that, अद्भुतम् marvel, प्रादुरासीत् appeared, भूतलात् from the face of the earth, उत्थितम् risen, दिव्यम् heavenly, अनुत्तमम् unsurpassed, सिंहासनम् lion-throne
entries.97.19: अमितविक्रमैः of measureless valour, दिव्यरत्नविभूषितैः adorned with heavenly gems, नागैः by nagas, शिरोभिः तु upon their heads indeed, दिव्येन with heavenly, वपुषा form, दिव्यम् the divine seat, ध्रियमाणम् borne up
entries.97.20: तस्मिन् in that, धरणी देवी तु and the goddess Earth, बाहुभ्याम् with both arms, मैथिलीम् Maithili, गृह्य having taken, स्वागतेन with welcome, एनाम् her, अभिनन्द्य having greeted, आसने upon the seat, उपवेशयत् च and seated her
entries.97.21: आसनगताम् seated upon the throne, रसातलम् into the nether world, प्रविशन्तीम् entering, ताम् her, दृष्ट्वा having seen, अविच्छिन्ना unbroken, दिव्या heavenly, पुष्पवृष्टिः a rain of flowers, सीताम् Sita, अवाकिरत् strewed over
entries.97.22: देवानाम् of the gods, सुमहान् exceedingly great, साधुकारश्च and a cry of approval, सहसा suddenly, उत्थितः arose, सीते O Sita, साधु साधु इति वै well done and well done indeed, यस्याः whose, ते your, शीलम् virtue, ईदृशम् is such
entries.97.23: एवम् thus, अन्तरिक्षगताः stationed in the sky, सुराः the gods, सीताप्रवेशनम् the entering of Sita, दृष्ट्वा having seen, हृष्टमनसः glad at heart, बहुविधाः of many kinds, वाचः हि words indeed, व्याजह्रुः uttered
entries.97.24: यज्ञवाटगताश्चापि and those in the sacrificial enclosure, ते they, सर्वे एव all, मुनयः sages, नरव्याघ्राः tigers among men, राजानश्च and the kings, विस्मयात् out of amazement, न उपरेमिरे could not compose themselves
entries.97.25: अन्तरिक्षे in the sky, भूमौ च and on the earth, सर्वे all, स्थावरजङ्गमाः things unmoving and moving, महाकायाः of huge frame, दानवाश्च and the danavas, पाताले in the nether world, पन्नगाधिपाः the lords of serpents
entries.97.26: केचित् some, संहृष्टाः thrilled, विनेदुः cried out, केचित् some, ध्यानपरायणाः lost in thought, केचित् some, रामम् Rama, निरीक्षन्ते gaze upon, केचित् some, अचेतनाः senseless, सीताम् at Sita
entries.97.27: सीताप्रवेशनम् the entering of Sita, दृष्ट्वा having seen, तेषाम् their, समागमः gathering, आसीत् was, तत् that, मुहूर्तम् for a moment, अत्यर्थम् इव exceedingly as it were, समम् alike, जगत् the world, सम्मोहितम् was stupefied
entries.98.1: वैदेह्याम् when Vaidehi, रसातलम् the nether world, प्रविष्टायाम् had entered, सर्ववानराः all the vanaras, मुनयः the sages, रामसन्निधौ in the presence of Rama, साधु साध्वी इति noble and virtuous, चुक्रुशुः cried out
entries.98.2: दण्डकाष्ठम् his staff, अवष्टभ्य leaning upon, बाष्पव्याकुलितेक्षणः his eyes clouded with tears, अवाक्छिराः his head bent down, दीनमनाः dejected in mind, रामः Rama, सुदुःखितः हि deeply grieved indeed, आसीत् was
entries.98.3: सः he, चिरम् for a long, कालम् time, रुदित्वा having wept, बहुशः again and again, बाष्पम् tears, उत्सृजन् shedding, क्रोधशोकसमाविष्टः filled with wrath and grief, रामः Rama, वचनम् these words, अब्रवीत् spoke
entries.98.4: अभूतपूर्वम् such as never was before, शोकम् grief, मे my, मनः mind, स्प्रष्टुम् इव as though to touch, इच्छति desires, मे as I, पश्यतः looked on, यथा how, रूपिणी embodied, श्रीः इव like Shri herself, सीता Sita, नष्टा was lost
entries.98.5: पुरा formerly, सा that, सीता Sita, महोदधेः of the great ocean, लङ्कापारे on the far side at Lanka, अदर्शनम् out of sight, ततश्चापि and even from thence, मया by me, आनीता was brought back, वसुधातलात् from beneath the earth, किं पुनः how much more
entries.98.6: वसुधे O Earth, देवि O goddess, भवति your ladyship, मम to me, सीता Sita, निर्यात्यताम् let her be restored, वा or, रोषम् my wrath, दर्शयिष्यामि I shall show, यथा so that, माम् me, अवगच्छसि you shall know
entries.98.7: त्वम् you, कामम् indeed, मम my, श्वश्रूः एव are my very mother-in-law, त्वत्सकाशात् हि from you indeed, मैथिली Maithili, पुरा of old, हलहस्तेन plough in hand, कर्षता as he ploughed, जनकेन by Janaka, उद्धृता was raised up
entries.98.8: तस्मात् therefore, सीता Sita, निर्यात्यताम् let her be restored, विवरम् वा or an opening, मे to me, प्रयच्छ grant, पाताले in the nether world, नाकपृष्ठे वा or on the vault of heaven, तया सहितः together with her, वसेयम् may I dwell
entries.98.9: त्वम् हि you indeed, ताम् that, सीताम् Sita, आनय bring, मैथिलीकृते on Maithili's account, अहम् I, मत्तः am beside myself, महीतले upon the face of the earth, यथारूपाम् in her own form, सीताम् Sita, मे to me, न दास्यसि चेत् if you will not give
entries.98.10: सपर्वतवनाम् with its mountains and forests, कृत्स्नाम् entire, ते your, स्थितम् standing ground, विधमिष्यामि I shall shatter, अहम् I, भूमिम् the earth, नाशयिष्यामि shall destroy, इह here, सर्वम् all, आपः water, भवतु let it become
entries.98.11: काकुत्स्थे when Kakutstha, क्रोधशोकसमन्विते filled with wrath and grief, एवम् thus, ब्रुवाणे spoke, ब्रह्मा Brahma, सुरगणैः सार्धम् along with the hosts of gods, रघुनन्दनम् to the delight of the Raghus, उवाच said
entries.98.12: राम राम O Rama O Rama, सुव्रत O you of good vows, सन्तापम् grief, कर्तुम् to make, न अर्हसि you ought not, अमित्रकर्शन O tormentor of foes, त्वम् you, पूर्वकम् your former, भावम् state, मन्त्रं च and the counsel, स्मर remember
entries.98.13: महाबाहो O mighty-armed one, दुर्धर्ष O unassailable one, अनुत्तमम् the unsurpassed, त्वाम् you, न खलु स्मारयेयम् I need surely not remind, इमम् this, मुहूर्तम् moment, त्वम् you, वैष्णवम् your Vishnu, जन्म birth, स्मर remember
entries.98.14: सीता Sita, विमला हि is indeed spotless, साध्वी virtuous, तव your, पूर्वपरायणा devoted to you from of old, त्वदाश्रयतपोबलात् by the power of the austerity that rests on you, सुखम् happily, नागलोकम् to the world of the nagas, प्रायात् has gone
entries.98.15: स्वर्गे in heaven, ते your, सङ्गमः meeting, भूयः again, भविष्यति shall be, न संशयः there is no doubt, अस्याः of this, परिषन्मध्ये in the midst of the assembly, यत् what, ब्रवीमि I say, तत् that, निबोध mark well
entries.98.16: राम O Rama, एतत् एव हि this very one indeed, ते your, काव्यम् poem, काव्यानाम् among poems, उत्तमम् the highest, श्रुतम् is renowned, सर्वम् all, विस्तरतः in full detail, व्याख्यास्यति it shall set forth, न संशयः there is no doubt
entries.98.17: वीर O hero, ते your, जन्मप्रभृति from birth onward, सुखदुःखोपसेवनम् the enduring of joy and sorrow, भविष्यत् what is to come, उत्तरं च and what follows, इह here, सर्वम् all, वाल्मीकिना by Valmiki, कृतम् has been made
entries.98.18: राम O Rama, इदम् this, आदिकाव्यम् first of poems, सर्वम् entirely, त्वयि in you, प्रतिष्ठितम् rests, राघवात् ऋते apart from Raghava, अन्यः another, काव्यानाम् of poems, यशोभाक् partaker of the fame, न हि अर्हति is not indeed worthy
entries.98.19: एतत् this, सर्वम् all, दिव्यम् heavenly, अद्भुतरूपं च and of wondrous form, सत्यवाक्यम् true in word, अनावृतम् unveiled, पूर्वम् formerly, मया by me, सुरैः सह along with the gods, श्रुतम् हि was indeed heard
entries.98.20: पुरुषशार्दूल O tiger among men, काकुत्स्थ O Kakutstha, सः त्वम् you being such, धर्मेण in dharma, सुसमाहितः well established, शेषम् the remainder, भविष्यम् what is to come, रामायणम् Ramayana, काव्यम् poem, शृणु hear
entries.98.21: महायशः O greatly renowned one, महातेज O you of great splendour, काव्यस्य of the poem, शेषम् the remainder, अत्र here, उत्तरं नाम is called the Uttara, उत्तमम् most excellent, तत् that, ऋषिभिः सार्धम् along with the sages, शृणुष्व hear
entries.98.22: काकुत्स्थ O Kakutstha, वीर O hero, रघुनन्दन O delight of the Raghus, इदम् this, उत्तमम् most excellent, परमम् supreme, अन्येन by another, न खलु श्रोतव्यम् is surely not to be heard, ऋषिणा by the sage, त्वया एव by you alone
entries.98.23: एतावत् this much, वचनम् speech, उक्त्वा having spoken, त्रिभुवनेश्वरः lord of the three worlds, देवः the god, ब्रह्मा Brahma, सबान्धवैः with his kinsmen, देवैः सह along with the gods, त्रिदिवम् to heaven, जगाम went
entries.98.24: ये च and those who, तत्र there, महात्मानः great-souled, ब्राह्मलौकिकाः dwellers in the world of Brahma, ऋषयः sages, महौजसः of great might, ब्रह्मणा by Brahma, समनुज्ञाताः permitted, राघवे concerning Raghava, यत् च and what, भविष्यम् is to come, उत्तरम् the Uttara, श्रोतुमनसः minded to hear, न्यवर्तन्त remained behind
entries.98.25: ततः then, परमतेजस्वी of supreme splendour, रामः Rama, देवदेवस्य of the god of gods, भाषिताम् spoken, शुभाम् auspicious, वाणीम् speech, श्रुत्वा having heard, वाल्मीकिम् to Valmiki, इदम् this, अब्रवीत् said
entries.98.26: भगवन् O venerable one, ब्राह्मलौकिकाः dwellers in the world of Brahma, ऋषयः the sages, श्रोतुमनसः are minded to hear, मे my, यत् what, भविष्यदुत्तरम् Uttara of things to come, श्वोभूते on the morrow, सम्प्रवर्तताम् let it proceed
entries.98.27: एवम् thus, विनिश्चयम् the resolve, कृत्वा having made, कुशीलवौ Kusha and Lava, सम्प्रगृह्य having taken with him, अथ then, तम् that, जनौघम् throng of people, विसृज्य having dismissed, पर्णशालाम् the leaf-hut, उपागमत् went to, ताम् एव that very, सीताम् Sita, शोचतः as he grieved for, सा that, शर्वरी night, व्यतीयाय passed away
entries.99.1: रजन्याम् तु and when the night, प्रभातायाम् had brightened into dawn, महामुनीन् the great sages, समानीय having assembled, रामः Rama, पुत्रौ to his two sons, अविशङ्काभ्याम् without misgiving, गीयताम् let it be sung, उवाच ह said
entries.99.2: ततः then, महात्मसु the great-souled, ब्रह्मर्षिषु when the brahmin sages, समुपविष्टेषु were seated, तौ those two, कुशीलवौ Kusha and Lava, भविष्यदुत्तरम् the Uttara of things to come, काव्यम् poem, जगतुः sang
entries.99.3: सीतायाम् तु and when Sita, सत्यसम्पदा by the power of her truth, भूतलम् the face of the earth, प्रविष्टायाम् had entered, तस्य its, यज्ञस्य of the sacrifice, अवसाने at the close, रामः Rama, परमदुर्मनाः utterly downcast
entries.99.4: वैदेहीम् Vaidehi, अपश्यमानः not seeing, इदम् this, जगत् world, शून्यम् empty, मेने deemed, शोकेन with grief, परमायस्तः utterly worn, मनसा in mind, शान्तिम् peace, न अगमत् came not to
entries.99.5: सर्वान् all, पार्थिवान् the kings, ऋक्षवानरराक्षसान् the bears and vanaras and rakshasas, विसृज्य having dismissed, विप्रमुख्यानाम् of the foremost of brahmins, जनौघम् the throng, वित्तपूर्वम् with gifts of wealth first, विसृज्य च and having dismissed
entries.99.6: सः तु and he, राघवः Raghava, एवम् thus, विधिवत् according to rule, यज्ञम् the sacrifice, समाप्य having completed, ततः then, राजीवलोचनः lotus-eyed, रामः Rama, तान् those, सर्वान् all, विसृज्य having dismissed
entries.99.7: इष्टयज्ञः having performed the sacrifice, पुत्रद्वयसमन्वितः accompanied by his two sons, नरपतिः the lord of men, तदा then, सीताम् Sita, हृदि in his heart, कृत्वा having kept, अयोध्याम् Ayodhya, प्रविवेश ह did indeed enter
entries.99.8: सः that, रघुनन्दनः delight of the Raghus, सीतायाः than Sita, पराम् another, भार्याम् wife, न वव्रे took not, यज्ञे यज्ञे at every sacrifice, पत्न्यर्थम् for the wife's part, काञ्चनी golden, जानकी Janaki, भवत् served
entries.99.9: अथ then, दशवर्षसहस्राणि for ten thousand years, वाजिमेधान् horse-sacrifices, अकरोत् performed, दशगुणान् tenfold, वाजपेयान् Vajapeyas, तथा likewise, बहुसुवर्णकान् rich in gold
entries.99.10: श्रीमान् the illustrious one, अग्निष्टोमातिरात्राभ्याम् with the Agnishtoma and the Atiratra, महाधनैः of great wealth, गोसवैश्च and with Gosava rites, आप्तदक्षिणैः with due sacrificial fees, अन्यैः with other, क्रतुभिश्च and rites, ईजे sacrificed
entries.99.11: एवम् thus, राज्यस्थस्य of him established in the kingdom, धर्मे in dharma, प्रयतमानस्य striving, महात्मनः of the great-souled, राघवस्य तु Raghava indeed, सुमहान् a very long, कालः time, व्यतीयात् passed
entries.99.12: रामस्य of Rama, शासने in the rule, स्थिताः abiding, ऋक्षवानररक्षांसि the bears and vanaras and rakshasas, अहन्यहनि day after day, राजानम् the king, राघवम् Raghava, अनुरञ्जन्ति gladden
entries.99.13: काले in season, पर्जन्यः the rain-god, वर्षति rains, सुभिक्षम् plenty, विमलाः clear, दिशः the quarters, पुरम् the city, तथा likewise, जनपदाः the country parts, हृष्टपुष्टजनाकीर्णम् thronged with glad and thriving folk
entries.99.14: रामे when Rama, राज्यम् the kingdom, प्रशासति ruled, कश्चित् anyone, अकाले untimely, न म्रियते dies not, तथा likewise, प्राणिनाम् of living beings, व्याधिः न there is no disease, कश्चित् any, अनर्थः calamity, न विद्यते is not found
entries.99.15: अथ then, दीर्घस्य कालस्य after a long time, यशस्विनी the illustrious, राममाता mother of Rama, पुत्रपौत्रैः by sons and grandsons, परिवृता surrounded, कालधर्मम् the law of time, उपागमत् met with
entries.99.16: सुमित्रा च and Sumitra, यशस्विनी the illustrious, कैकेयी च and Kaikeyi, अन्वियाय followed after, बहुविधम् of many kinds, धर्मम् dharma, कृत्वा having practised, त्रिदिवे in heaven, पर्यवस्थिता took their place
entries.99.17: सर्वाः all of them, महाभागाः greatly blessed, स्वर्गे in heaven, प्रमुदिताः rejoicing, राज्ञा with king, दशरथेन च and Dasharatha, समागताः reunited, सर्वधर्मं च and every merit, लेभिरे obtained
entries.99.18: रामः Rama, तासाम् for them, मातॄणाम् his mothers, अविशेषेण without distinction, काले काले from time to time, ब्राह्मणेषु among brahmins, तपस्विषु among ascetics, महादानम् great gifts, प्रयच्छति bestows
entries.99.19: धर्मात्मा the righteous, रामः Rama, पितॄन् the fathers, देवान् the gods, विवर्धयन् magnifying, पित्र्याणि due to the fathers, ब्रह्मरत्नानि gifts of jewels to brahmins, परमदुस्तरान् most arduous, यज्ञान् sacrifices, चकार performed
entries.99.20: एवम् thus, यज्ञैः with sacrifices, बहुविधम् of many kinds, धर्मम् dharma, सर्वदा ever, वर्धयानस्य of him increasing, बहूनि many, वर्षसहस्राणि thousands of years, अथ then, सुखम् happily, ययुः passed
entries.100.1: अथ then, कस्यचित् तु after a certain, कालस्य time, केकयः the Kekaya, नृपः king, युधाजित् Yudhajit, महात्मने to the great-souled, राघवाय Raghava, स्वगुरुम् his own preceptor, अङ्गिरसः of Angiras, पुत्रम् the son, अमितप्रभम् of measureless lustre, ब्रह्मर्षिम् the brahmin sage, गार्ग्यम् Gargya, प्रेषयामास sent
entries.100.2: दश ten, अश्वसहस्राणि thousands of horses, अनुत्तमम् most excellent, प्रीतिदानम् as a gift of affection
entries.100.3: राजा the king, रामाय to Rama, कम्बलानि woollen blankets, रत्नानि च and jewels, अथ and, उत्तमम् most excellent, चित्रवस्त्रम् figured cloth, शुभानि fair, आभरणानि च and ornaments, प्रददौ gave
entries.100.4: धीमान् the wise, राघवः Raghava, मातुलस्य of his maternal uncle, अश्वपतिनः lord of horses, प्रहितम् sent, तत् that, महाधनम् great treasure, महर्षिम् the great sage, गार्ग्यम् Gargya, आगतम् having come, श्रुत्वा तु having heard
entries.100.5: काकुत्स्थः Kakutstha, सहानुजः along with his brothers, क्रोशमात्रम् a full krosha, प्रत्युद्गम्य च and having gone forth to meet, शक्रः Shakra, बृहस्पतिम् Brihaspati, यथा as, गार्ग्यम् Gargya, सम्पूजयामास honoured
entries.100.6: तथा so, तम् that, ऋषिम् sage, सम्पूज्य having honoured, तत् that, धनम् treasure, प्रतिगृह्य च and having received, मातुलस्य of his maternal uncle, सर्वम् all, प्रतिपदम् point by point, कुशलं च and the welfare, पृष्ट्वा having asked, रामः Rama, उपविष्टम् seated, महाभागम् the greatly blessed one, प्रष्टुम् to question, प्रचक्रमे set about
entries.100.7: मातुलः my maternal uncle, किम् what, वाक्यम् word, आह has sent, यदर्थम् for what purpose, भगवान् your honour, वाक्यविदाम् among masters of speech, श्रेष्ठः the best, साक्षात् in very person, बृहस्पतिः इव like Brihaspati, इह here, प्राप्तः has come
entries.100.8: महर्षिः the great sage, रामस्य of Rama, भाषितम् the speech, श्रुत्वा having heard, अद्भुतसङ्काशम् wondrous to hear, कार्यविस्तरम् the full account of the business, राघवाय to Raghava, वक्तुम् to tell, उपचक्रमे set about
entries.100.9: महाबाहो O mighty-armed one, नरर्षभः the bull among men, ते your, मातुलः maternal uncle, युधाजित् Yudhajit, प्रीतिसंयुक्तम् filled with affection, वाक्यम् a word, आह has spoken, यदि if, रोचते it please you, श्रूयताम् let it be heard
entries.100.10: अयम् this, गन्धर्वविषयः realm of the gandharvas, फलमूलोपशोभितः rich in fruit and root, सिन्धोः of the Sindhu, उभयतः on both, पार्श्वे sides, परमशोभनः most beautiful, देशः a land
entries.100.11: वीर O hero, तं च and it, सायुधाः armed, युद्धकोविदाः skilled in battle, महाबलाः mighty, शैलूषस्य of Shailusha, सुताः the sons, त्रिकोट्यः वै three crores indeed, गन्धर्वाः gandharvas, रक्षन्ति guard
entries.100.12: काकुत्स्थ O Kakutstha, महाबाहो O mighty-armed one, तान् them, विनिर्जित्य having conquered, शुभम् the fair, गन्धर्वनगरम् city of the gandharvas, सुसमाहिते well ordered, स्वे in your own, पुरे city, निवेशय settle
entries.100.13: महाबाहो O mighty-armed one, तत्र there, अन्यस्य for another, गतिः न there is no access, देशः the land, परमशोभनः is most beautiful, ते to you, रोचताम् let it be pleasing, अहम् I, त्वाम् to you, अहितम् what is harmful, न वदे speak not
entries.100.14: राघवः Raghava, तत् that, श्रुत्वा having heard, महर्षेः of the great sage, मातुलस्य च and of his maternal uncle, प्रीतः pleased, बाढम् इति एव so be it indeed, उवाच said, भरतं च and toward Bharata, अन्ववैक्षत looked
entries.100.15: सः that, राघवः Raghava, प्रीतः pleased, साञ्जलिप्रग्रहः with joined palms in submission, द्विजम् to the brahmin, अब्रवीत् said, ब्रह्मर्षे O brahmin sage, इमौ these two, कुमारौ princes, तम् that, देशम् land, विचरिष्यतः shall range over
entries.100.16: वीरौ the two heroes, भरतस्य of Bharata, आत्मजौ sons, तक्षः Taksha, पुष्कल एव च and Pushkala, मातुलेन by their maternal uncle, सुगुप्तौ तु well guarded indeed, धर्मेण in dharma, सुसमाहितौ well established
entries.100.17: भरतम् Bharata, अग्रतः to the front, कृत्वा having placed, सबलानुगौ with their troops and followers, कुमारौ the two princes, गन्धर्वसुतान् the sons of the gandharvas, निहत्य having slain, द्वे two, पुरे cities, विभजिष्यतः shall divide between them
entries.100.18: अतिधार्मिकः the most righteous one, ते your, पुरवरे in those best of cities, आत्मजौ his sons, निवेश्य having settled, सन्निवेश्य च and having established them, भूयः again, मे my, सकाशम् presence, आगमिष्यति shall return to
entries.100.19: ब्रह्मर्षिम् to the brahmin sage, एवम् thus, उक्त्वा तु having spoken, तदा then, सबलानुगम् with his troops and followers, भरतम् Bharata, आज्ञापयामास he commanded, कुमारौ च and the two princes, अभ्यषेचयत् consecrated
entries.100.20: सौम्येन under an auspicious, नक्षत्रेण च and constellation, आङ्गिरस्सुतम् the son of Angiras, पुरस्कृत्य having set foremost, भरतः Bharata, कुमाराभ्याम् with the two princes, सैन्येन सह along with the army, विनिर्ययौ set forth
entries.100.21: सा that, सेना army, शक्रयुक्ता इव as though led by Shakra, अथ then, नगरात् from the city, निर्ययौ went out, राघवानुगता accompanied by Raghava, दूरम् far, सुरैः अपि even by the gods, दुराधर्षा unassailable
entries.100.22: मांसादानि flesh-eating, सत्त्वानि creatures, सुमहान्ति च and very great, रक्षांसि rakshasas, रुधिरस्य for blood, पिपासया out of thirst, भरतम् Bharata, अनुजग्मुः हि did indeed follow
entries.100.23: बहवः many, मांसभक्षाः flesh-eating, सुदारुणाः most dreadful, भूतग्रामाश्च and troops of beings, सहस्रशः by the thousand, गन्धर्वपुत्रमांसानि the flesh of the sons of the gandharvas, भोक्तुकामाः eager to feed on
entries.100.24: सिंहव्याघ्रवराहाणाम् of lions and tigers and boars, खेचराणाम् of the sky-ranging, पक्षिणाम् च and of birds, बहूनि many, सहस्राणि वै thousands indeed, सेनायाः of the army, अग्रतः ahead, ययुः went
entries.100.25: पथि on the road, अध्यर्धमासम् a month and a half, उषिता having halted, निरामया free of sickness, हृष्टपुष्टजनाकीर्णा thronged with glad and thriving folk, सेना the army, केकयम् the Kekaya land, समुपागमत् reached
entries.101.1: केकयाधिपः the lord of the Kekayas, युधाजित् Yudhajit, गार्ग्यसहितम् accompanied by Gargya, सेनापतिम् the commander of the army, भरतम् Bharata, प्राप्तम् arrived, श्रुत्वा having heard, पराम् the utmost, प्रीतिम् joy, उपागमत् came to
entries.101.2: सः that, केकयाधिपः lord of the Kekayas, महता with a great, जनौघेन throng of people, निर्ययौ went forth, त्वरमाणः hastening, कामरूपिणः taking any form at will, गन्धर्वान् the gandharvas, अभिचक्राम marched against
entries.101.3: भरतश्च and Bharata, युधाजिच्च and Yudhajit, लघुविक्रमैः with swift-moving troops, समेतौ united, सबलौ with their forces, सपदानुगौ with their followers, गन्धर्वनगरम् the city of the gandharvas, प्राप्तौ reached
entries.101.4: भरतम् Bharata, प्राप्तम् arrived, श्रुत्वा तु having heard, ते those, गन्धर्वाः gandharvas, समागताः gathered, महावीर्याः of great might, योद्धुकामाः eager to fight, समन्ततः on every side, व्यनदन् वै roared indeed
entries.101.5: ततः then, तुमुलम् tumultuous, रोमहर्षणम् hair-raising, महाभीमम् most terrible, युद्धम् a battle, सप्तरात्रम् for seven nights, समभवत् took place, अन्यतरयोः of either side, जयः victory, न च came not
entries.101.6: खड्गशक्तिधनुर्ग्राहाः bearing swords and spears and bows, शोणितसंस्रवाः streaming with blood, नृकलेवरवाहिन्यः carrying the bodies of men, नद्यः rivers, सर्वतोदिशम् in every direction, प्रवृत्ताः began to flow
entries.101.7: ततः then, रामानुजः the younger brother of Rama, भरतः Bharata, क्रुद्धः enraged, कालस्य of Kala, सुदारुणम् most terrible, संवर्तं नाम Samvarta by name, अस्त्रम् the missile, गन्धर्वेषु against the gandharvas, अभ्यचोदयत् loosed
entries.101.8: ते they, कालपाशेन by the noose of Kala, बद्धाः bound, संवर्तेन by the Samvarta, विदारिताः torn asunder, तेन by it, क्षणेन in a moment, महात्मनाम् of the great-souled, तिस्रः three, कोट्यः crores, अभिहताः were struck down
entries.101.9: दिवौकसः the dwellers of heaven, निमेषान्तरमात्रेण in the space of but a blink, तादृशानाम् of such, महात्मनाम् great-souled ones, घोरसङ्काशम् dreadful to behold, तम् that, घातम् slaughter, न स्मरन्ति do not recall
entries.101.10: तेषु when they, सर्वेषु all, हतेषु had been slain, केकयीसुतः son of Kaikeyi, भरतः Bharata, तदा then, समृद्धे prosperous, द्वे two, पुरोत्तमे best of cities, निवेशयामास founded
entries.101.11: सः he, तक्षम् Taksha, तक्षशिलायाम् तु at Takshashila indeed, पुष्कलम् Pushkala, पुष्कलावते at Pushkalavata, रुचिरे in the lovely, गन्धर्वदेशे land of the gandharvas, गान्धारविषये च and in the Gandhara realm
entries.101.12: धनरत्नौघसङ्कीर्णे strewn with floods of wealth and jewels, काननैः with woods, उपशोभिते adorned, स्पर्धया in rivalry, गुणविस्तरैः by the range of their excellences, अन्योन्यसङ्घर्षकृते set to vie with one another
entries.101.13: उभे both, सुरुचिरप्रख्ये of most beautiful appearance, अकिल्बिषैः free of fraud, व्यवहारैः in their dealings, उद्यानयानसम्पूर्णे filled with gardens and carriages, सुविभक्तान्तरापणे their markets well laid out within
entries.101.14: उभे both, रम्ये delightful, पुरवरे best of cities, विस्तरैः with wide spaces, उपशोभिते adorned, विमानसमवर्णिभिः rivalling aerial cars in hue, सुरुचिरैः most beautiful, गृहमुख्यैः with noble mansions
entries.101.15: शोभनीयैः fair to see, देवायतनविस्तरैश्च and with spacious temples of the gods, शोभिते adorned, तालैः with palms, तमालैः with tamalas, तिलकैः with tilakas, वकुलैः with bakulas, उपशोभिते made lovely
entries.101.16: राघवानुजः the younger brother of Raghava, महाबाहुः the mighty-armed, केकयीसुतः son of Kaikeyi, भरतः Bharata, पञ्चभिः in five, वर्षैः years, निवेश्य having settled them, पुनः again, अयोध्याम् to Ayodhya, आयात् returned
entries.101.17: श्रीमान् the illustrious, भरतः Bharata, अपरम् another, साक्षात् in very person, धर्मम् इव like Dharma, महात्मानम् the great-souled, राघवम् Raghava, वासवः Vasava, ब्रह्माणम् इव as he does Brahma, अभिवाद्य having saluted
entries.101.18: यथावृत्तम् just as it had befallen, उत्तमम् the excellent, गन्धर्ववधम् slaying of the gandharvas, देशस्य of the land, निवेशनं च and the settling, शशंस च and recounted, राघवः Raghava, श्रुत्वा having heard, अस्य with him, प्रीतः was pleased
